info.title: Polymorfa Console & Management API
info.description:
Complete console/management surface. Resource-oriented REST: `{param}` path variables, single-word action sub-resources.

Namespaces decide inclusion:
- `/v1/…` — **public registry** (71 endpoints): each endpoint declares either a scoped `pmfa_` organization key or a verified live dashboard JWT, or dashboard-only authorization when a specific user's authority is required. Only implemented handlers are published to customers and SDKs.
- `/console/…` — **console-only** (50 endpoints): verified dashboard identity. EXCLUDED from the published spec; reason per endpoint.
- `/admin/…` — **staff-only** (48 endpoints): Polymorfa internal staff. EXCLUDED.

The published customer spec = this document filtered to `x-audience: public` endpoints with an implemented runtime handler.
Most transitional body/response schemas remain loose (`additionalProperties: true`); session-control operations use explicit strict schemas.

get.description:
Returns whether Customers is enabled for the exact project and its protected default Customer when enabled.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:read`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

post.description:
Enables Customers once, creates the default Customer, and assigns every existing Number in the project to it atomically.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:manage`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

get.description:
Lists masked Customer summaries in the exact authenticated project with cursor pagination and filters.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:read`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

post.description:
Creates a Customer with optional name, phone, and caller-defined external identifier.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:manage`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

get.description:
Returns one Customer from the exact authenticated project.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:read`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

patch.description:
Updates supplied Customer profile fields. Null clears an optional field.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:manage`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

post.description:
Archives a non-default Customer. The default Customer cannot be archived.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:manage`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

post.description:
Restores an archived Customer.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:manage`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

get.description:
Lists Numbers assigned to one Customer in the exact project.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:read`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

get.description:
Lists the newest Customer lifecycle events with safe metadata. Actor identities, message content, phone values, invitation tokens, and URLs are excluded.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:read`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

post.description:
Creates a revocable Customer invitation. The raw URL is returned only in this response.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:manage`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

get.description:
Lists safe pairing-link metadata. Raw invitation tokens and URLs are never returned.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:read`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

delete.description:
Revokes an open pairing link.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:manage`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

post.description:
Atomically transfers one eligible Number from the explicitly confirmed source Customer to the destination Customer.

Organization API-key callers require `customers:manage`; project-token callers require the same action scope and are accepted only for `project` resources inside the authenticated project; dashboard callers require current organization membership and authorization.

allowedOrigins.description: Up to 50 exact HTTPS origins without credentials, paths, queries, fragments, or commas. A trailing root slash is accepted and removed.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used to generate a realistic E.164 identity.
